All signs.voice_body:
SENSE the surge of Mars opposite Pluto on 2026‑10‑02, a clash that turns raw ambition into deep transformation. Mars, the driver, feels Pluto’s shadow—power, control, and hidden desires—stiffening the path ahead. This tension signals a choice: either push forward with force or release what no longer serves you.

Use the day’s pressure as a mirror, not a mandate. Acknowledge the urge to dominate, then pause and ask, “What can I let go to move forward?” Let the moment guide a single act of release—perhaps a brief meditation or a written note of what you’re ready to surrender. This concrete step turns conflict into growth.
